g1.flow: Three near-matches that change one piece at a time, in muṣḥaf order. Fuṣṣilat: inna lladhīna … lahum, after those who do not give zakāh. Al-Inshiqāq: illā lladhīna … lahum, after 'tidings of a painful punishment'. At-Tīn: illā lladhīna … fa-lahum, after 'the lowest of the low'. Hook: inna, then illā, then illā plus fa. The last surah gets the extra fa.

cues.41:8: Inna, no fa: after those who do not give zakāh and disbelieve in the Hereafter.
cues.84:25: Illā … lahum, no fa: after 'tidings of a painful punishment'; last ayah of the surah.
cues.95:6: Illā … fa-lahum: after 'lowest of the low'; next, what causes you to deny the Recompense?
